input: Write liner notes for my self-recorded EP

gold.taskTitle: Write Liner Notes for Your Self-Recorded EP
gold.taskDescription: Draft liner notes to accompany the user's self-recorded EP for physical or digital release.

questions.title: What is the title and theme of your EP?
questions.description: Understanding the EP's title and central theme or concept will shape the tone and content of the liner notes.

questions.title: Who is the intended audience for these liner notes?
questions.description: Knowing whether the audience is existing fans, new listeners, or industry professionals affects the writing style and depth.

questions.title: What story or message do you want the notes to convey?
questions.description: Identifying the core narrative — personal journey, creative process, or a specific message — gives the liner notes direction.

questions.title: How many tracks are on the EP, and what are their titles?
questions.description: The track list determines whether the liner notes cover each song individually or address the EP as a whole.

questions.title: Where will these liner notes appear physically or digitally?
questions.description: Whether they go inside a CD booklet, a vinyl sleeve, a Bandcamp page, or a streaming bio changes the format and length.

questions.title: What is the approximate word count or length you want?
questions.description: A target length ensures the notes fit the format and match the user's expectations for depth.

questions.title: Should the notes be written in first person or third person?
questions.description: The grammatical perspective affects the intimacy and professionalism of the final piece.
